q: Biology is broadly divided into five major themes. (2024-Set 3)
e: Biology is broadly divided into five major themes.

q: The wings of hummingbird cannot rotate at the shoulder. (2025-Set-5)
e: The wings of a hummingbird can rotate at the shoulder.

q: Eukaryotic cells contain membrane-enclosed organelles. (2025- Set 9)
e: Eukaryotic cells contain membrane-enclosed organelles.

q: Prokaryotic cells have membrane-enclosed organelles. (2025- Set-8)
e: Prokaryotic cells lack membrane-enclosed organelles.

q: Prokaryotic cells contain membrane-enclosed organelles. (2024-နိုင်ငံခြား)
e: Prokaryotic cells do not contain membrane-enclosed organelles.

q: The DNA transmits heritable information from offspring to parents. (2025-Set 11)
e: DNA transmits heritable information from parents to offspring.

q: All organisms require energy for their life. (2025- Set 3)
e: All organisms require energy for their life processes.

q: Chemical cycle occurs between organisms and the environment. (2025- Set 10/2026-Set 1)
e: Chemical cycling occurs between organisms and the environment.

q: Plants take up nutrients from the soil and chemicals from the air and use energy from the sun. (2026-နိုင်ငံခြား)
e: Plants absorb soil nutrients, air chemicals, and harness solar energy.

q: Plants take up nutrients from the soil. (2025- Set 5)
e: Plants take up nutrients from the soil.

q: Plants take up nutrients from the chemicals and soil from the air. (2025- Set 9)
e: Plants take up nutrients from the soil and chemicals from the air.

q: Evolution is the process of change that has transformed life on Earth. (2024-Set 2)
e: Evolution is the process of change that has transformed life on Earth.

q: Domain Bacteria and Archaea consist of Prokaryotes. (2024-နောက်ဆက်တွဲမေးခွန်း)
e: Domain Bacteria and Archaea consist of prokaryotic organisms.

q: The relevance of biology is the importance of the human society and humankind. (2025- Set 10)
e: The relevance of biology relates directly to the importance of human society and humankind.

q: Myanmar is the leading pulse and bean producer. (2026-Set 2)
e: Myanmar is a leading pulse and bean producer.

q: Floriculture is the production of fruits and nuts. (2025-Set 12)
e: Floriculture is the cultivation and production of flowers.

q: Pomology is the vegetable growing, dealing with the culture of woody plants. (2025-Set 6)
e: Pomology is the production of fruits and nuts; olericulture is vegetable growing.

q: Pomology or fruticulture is the production of flowers. (2025- Set 4)
e: Pomology or fruticulture is the production of fruits and nuts.

q: Olericulture is the production of grapes. (2025- Set 2)
e: Olericulture is the production of vegetables.

q: Pomology is the production of fruits and nuts. (2025- Set-7)
e: Pomology is the production of fruits and nuts.

q: Domain Bacteria and Eukarya consist of prokaryotes. (2024-Set 4)
e: Domains Bacteria and Archaea consist of prokaryotes, whereas Eukarya consists of eukaryotes.

q: Commercially cultivating agricultural crops in Myanmar are mainly cereals, pulses and oilseed crops. (2024-Set 4)
e: Main commercially cultivated crops in Myanmar include cereals, pulses, and oilseeds.

q: Mariculture is farming of algae species. (2026-Set 1)
e: Mariculture is marine organism farming; aquafarming covers algae species including microalgae.

q: Aquafarming is the farming of algae species including microalgae and seaweed. (2025-Set 6)
e: Statement misdefines specific aquaculture terminology according to the textbook.

q: Shrimp farming is an aquaculture business that exists in either a marine or freshwater environment. (2025- Set 8)
e: Shrimp farming exists in marine or freshwater environments.

q: Livestock are key drivers for sustainable development in agriculture. (2025- Set 7)
e: Livestock serve as key drivers for sustainable agricultural development.

q: Fish farming or pisciculture involves commercial harvesting of fish. (2024-Set 2)
e: Pisciculture involves controlled breeding and rearing of fish rather than general harvesting.

q: The blood and bone of animals are also used as fertilizer. (2024-ရန်ကုန်နှင့်တိုင်းခရိုင်အများတွင်မေး/2025-Set 13)
e: Animal blood and bone meal are used as fertilizers.

q: Food is one of the major requirements of life. (2024-ရန်ကုန်နှင့်တိုင်းခရိုင်အများတွင်မေး)
e: Food is one of the essential requirements of life.

q: Spider silk is referred to by many scientists as bio-fuel. (2025- Set 2)
e: Spider silk is referred to by scientists as bio-steel.

q: Spider silk is referred to by many scientists as bio-steel. (2024-Set 3၊ နိုင်ငံခြား/2025- Set 4, 13)
e: Spider silk is known as bio-steel due to its high strength.

q: Leeches are small, voracious eaters that can eat ten times, its own body weight of blood. (2024-နောက်ဆက်တွဲမေးခွန်း)
e: Leeches can consume up to five times their body weight in blood.

q: Maggots are small, voracious eaters that feed on diseased and dying flesh. (2025-Set 11)
e: Maggots feed on necrotic, diseased, and dying flesh.

q: Fibre colour is the most important wool characteristic determining quality and price. (2026-နိုင်ငံခြား)
e: Fibre fineness (diameter) is the most critical characteristic determining wool quality.

q: Wool is the textile fibre obtained from plants. (2025-Set 12)
e: Wool is an animal fiber obtained from sheep and other animals.

q: Silkworm has two stages in its life cycle. (2025 Set 3)
e: The silkworm goes through four distinct stages in its life cycle.

q: Wool as well as cotton has also been traditionally used for cloth diapers. (2025- Set 1)
e: Wool and cotton are traditionally used materials for cloth diapers.

q: The major portion of the timber is used for structural purpose. (2025- Set 1)
e: The main portion of harvested timber is used for structural purposes.
